<thought>We need the template ID for the sulfonamide formation step (amine + phenylsulfonyl chloride → sulfonamide). The functional group broken is an acyl chloride (the S‑Cl bond in phenylsulfonyl chloride) and the functional group formed is a sulfonamide. We'll search the template catalog using these valid functional group names.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
  "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
